headline: guoqin gu surges up ARC-2 standings

sections.text: guoqin gu gained 18.75 points to reach 46.39, moving from 1,764th to 29th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
At 29th, guoqin gu remains outside the 15 gold places; the last gold position currently carries 57.08.
